title: pvLegacyVTKReader
body:
## pvLegacyVTKReader

Reads a legacy-format VTK file (.vtk, ASCII or binary), the older single-file format that can hold structured points (image data), a structured, rectilinear or unstructured grid, or polydata, with point and cell arrays; the output type is whatever the file stores. Several file names form a time series, one file per step. Prefer the VTK XML readers (pvXMLPolyDataReader, pvXMLUnstructuredGridReader, …) for new data; use pvPartitionedLegacyVTKReader for a .pvtk set of pieces.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- List the files of a series in their intended time order; ParaView reads them in the order given.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `LegacyVTKReader`. Identity: `sources/LegacyVTKFileReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvLegacyVTKReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
